tasks.title: Audit and backup ComfyUI directory before deletion

tasks.details:
1. Navigate to G:\VbN\ComfyUI\ directory
2. Generate a complete file listing using 'dir /s > comfyui_audit.txt' (Windows) or 'find . -type f > comfyui_audit.txt' (Unix)
3. Review the audit file to identify any non-ComfyUI files that might be critical to the project
4. Create a backup of the entire ComfyUI directory to a temporary location outside the project

tasks.testStrategy: Verify backup integrity by comparing file counts and sizes between original and backup directories. Confirm audit file contains complete directory structure listing.

tasks.details:

tasks.title: Update Page Links from index.php to character_sheet.php
tasks.description: Update all internal and external links, references, and redirects that point to index.php for character viewing to now point to character_sheet.php instead.
tasks.details:
1. Identify all files that contain references to index.php for character viewing:
   - Search through all PHP files, HTML files, and JavaScript files for references to index.php
   - Focus on links, form actions, redirects, and AJAX calls that specifically relate to character viewing

2. Update the following types of references:
   - HTML anchor tags: `<a href="index.php?character_id=123">` → `<a href="character_sheet.php?character_id=123">`
   - Form actions: `<form action="index.php" method="post">` → `<form action="character_sheet.php" method="post">`
   - PHP redirects: `header('Location: index.php?character_id=' . $id);` → `header('Location: character_sheet.php?character_id=' . $id);`
   - JavaScript/AJAX calls: `fetch('index.php?character_id='+id)` → `fetch('character_sheet.php?character_id='+id)`
   - Include/require statements if relevant: `include('index.php')` → `include('character_sheet.php')`

3. Pay special attention to these specific files:
   - player_dashboard.php (character links)
   - admin_dashboard.php (character management links)
   - Any navigation menus or sidebar components
   - Any JavaScript files that handle character viewing or editing
   - Any PHP files that process character data and redirect to the character sheet

4. Update any URL parameters or query strings while maintaining their functionality:
   - Preserve all GET parameters when updating URLs
   - Ensure any character_id, action, or other parameters remain intact

5. Check for any conditional logic that might reference the filename:
   ```php
   if (basename($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']) == 'index.php') {
       // Update this condition
   }
   ```

6. Document all changes made in a changelog for reference.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Create a comprehensive test plan that covers all updated links:
   - Compile a list of all files modified and the specific changes made
   - For each modified file, test the functionality that involves links to character viewing

2. Test all navigation paths to character sheets:
   - From player dashboard to character sheet
   - From admin dashboard to character sheet
   - From character listings to individual character sheets
   - Any other navigation paths that should lead to character viewing

3. Test form submissions:
   - Verify that any forms that previously posted to index.php now correctly post to character_sheet.php
   - Confirm that form processing and data handling works as expected

4. Test with different user roles:
   - Log in as a regular player and test character viewing
   - Log in as an admin/storyteller and test character viewing
   - Verify that appropriate permissions are maintained

5. Test URL parameters:
   - Verify that character_sheet.php properly handles all the same URL parameters and query strings that index.php did
   - Test with various combinations of parameters

6. Regression testing:
   - Ensure that no functionality has been broken by the link updates
   - Verify that character viewing, editing, and all related features work exactly as they did before

7. Browser testing:
   - Test in multiple browsers to ensure compatibility
   - Check that browser bookmarks or saved links are handled appropriately (consider adding redirects if necessary)

tasks.title: Implement Header and Footer Includes in Existing Pages
tasks.description: Add header.php and footer.php includes to existing pages (dashboard.php, lotn_char_create.php, chat.php, character_sheet.php, users.php) to ensure consistent styling and navigation across the application.
tasks.details:
1. Identify all target pages that need header and footer includes:
   - dashboard.php
   - lotn_char_create.php
   - chat.php
   - character_sheet.php
   - users.php

2. For each page, add the header include at the beginning of the file, right after any initial PHP code:
   ```php
   <?php
   session_start();
   // Any existing authentication or setup code
   
   // Include header
   require_once 'includes/header.php';
   ?>
   ```

3. For each page, add the footer include at the end of the file, before the closing HTML tag:
   ```php
   <?php
   // Include footer
   require_once 'includes/footer.php';
   ?>
   </body>
   </html>
   ```

4. Ensure that any existing HTML structure is modified to accommodate the header and footer:
   - Remove any duplicate <!DOCTYPE>, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags that would now be included via header.php
   - Remove any duplicate closing </body> or </html> tags that would now be included via footer.php
   - Move any page-specific CSS or JavaScript to appropriate locations that work with the header/footer structure

5. Update any page-specific title tags to work with the header include:
   - If the header.php uses a dynamic title, add a variable before including the header:
   ```php
   <?php
   $pageTitle = "Dashboard"; // Set page-specific title
   require_once 'includes/header.php';
   ?>
   ```

6. Test each page individually to ensure proper rendering with the new includes.

7. Verify that session handling and authentication still work correctly with the modified file structure.

8. Check for any CSS conflicts between page-specific styles and the gothic theme applied by the header/footer.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Create a testing checklist for each page to verify:
   - Header appears correctly with Valley by Night title, logo placeholder, username, and version number
   - Footer appears correctly with Valley by Night title link and copyright notice
   - Gothic styling is consistently applied
   - Page-specific functionality continues to work

2. Test each page individually:
   - dashboard.php: Verify dashboard content displays correctly between header and footer
   - lotn_char_create.php: Test character creation form functionality with new includes
   - chat.php: Ensure chat interface works properly with header and footer
   - character_sheet.php: Verify character sheet displays and functions correctly
   - users.php: Test user management functionality with new includes

3. Test navigation between pages to ensure links in header and footer work correctly.

4. Perform cross-browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) to verify consistent appearance.

5. Test responsive design by checking each page at various screen sizes:
   - Mobile (320px-480px width)
   - Tablet (768px-1024px width)
   - Desktop (1200px+ width)

6. Verify session persistence across pages with the new includes structure.

7. Check for any JavaScript errors in browser console that might be caused by the restructuring.

8. Validate HTML for each page to ensure proper structure after adding includes.

tasks.title: Update Documentation with New Page Structure and Header/Footer Usage
tasks.description: Update the START_HERE.md file to document the new page structure, provide guidelines for header/footer usage, and update the version number to v0.5.0 throughout the application.
tasks.details:
1. Update the START_HERE.md file with the following sections:

   a. Application Structure:
   ```markdown
   ## Application Structure
   
   The Valley by Night application now uses a new page structure:
   - `index.php`: Main dashboard/landing page with role-based redirection
   - `player_dashboard.php`: Dashboard for regular players
   - `admin_dashboard.php`: Dashboard for admins and storytellers
   - `character_sheet.php`: Character viewing and editing (formerly index.php)
   - `includes/`: Directory containing reusable components
     - `header.php`: Standard header with Valley by Night styling
     - `footer.php`: Standard footer with Valley by Night styling
     - `character_queries.php`: Functions for character database operations
   ```
   
   b. Header and Footer Usage:
   ```markdown
   ## Using Header and Footer Components
   
   All pages should include the standardized header and footer components for consistent styling:
   
   ```php
   <?php
